data.desc: The Company, through its wholly owned operating subsidiary, United Business Bank, offers a full range of loans, including SBA, CalCAP, FSA and USDA guaranteed loans, and deposit products and services to businesses and their affiliates in California, Nevada, Washington, New Mexico and Colorado. The Bank is an Equal Housing Lender and a member of FDIC. The Company's common stock is traded on the NASDAQ under the symbol 'BCML'. For more information, go to www.unitedbusinessbank.com.
